obligation_occurrences_confirmation.name: obligation_occurrences_confirmation
obligation_occurrences_confirmation.value: ("obligation_occurrences"."status" IN ('paid', 'attended')) = ("obligation_occurrences"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "obligation_occurrences"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL)

rent_charges_confirmation.name: rent_charges_confirmation
rent_charges_confirmation.value: ("rent_charges"."status" = 'received') = ("rent_charges"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rent_charges"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "rent_charges"."confirmation_evidence" IS NOT NULL)

case_proposals_review.name: case_proposals_review
case_proposals_review.value: ("case_proposals"."review_status" IN ('accepted', 'rejected')) = ("case_proposals"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "case_proposals"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL)

hitl_requests_decision.name: hitl_requests_decision
hitl_requests_decision.value: ("hitl_requests"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected')) = ("hitl_requests"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "hitl_requests"."responded_at" IS NOT NULL)

workflow_jobs_lease.name: workflow_jobs_lease
workflow_jobs_lease.value: ("workflow_jobs"."status" = 'claimed') = ("workflow_jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "workflow_jobs"."locked_until" IS NOT NULL)

alerts_resolved.name: alerts_resolved
alerts_resolved.value: ("alerts"."state" = 'resolved') = ("alerts"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "alerts"."resolution_reason" IS NOT NULL)
